resolutions.phrase: The eighteen-month retention for Quillmoor field recordings, set on the 1 October planning call

referents.why: Odette Varga's 1 October statement that raw field recordings are kept eighteen months is the position replaced by twelve months.

resolutions.why: The only node in the graph holding the eighteen-month Quillmoor recording retention is the 1 October planning-call expression. The phrase names it directly.

resolutions.phrase: Transcripts are still kept permanently; only the recordings change.

referents.why: Restates the standing 'transcripts we keep permanently' position from the same expression and clarifies that only the recordings change.

resolutions.why: 'Still kept permanently' points back to the one transcript-retention position in the graph. That position is in the same expression as the recordings rule.
